meta.source: hinterlandweb.com live CSS (:root and .dark blocks), read 2026-10-20

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is Hinterland navy, the site's default; light is sage.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `background`, `muted` and `frame`.

tokens.name: headline
tokens.usage: Hero headline and big display type on `background` or over the painted sky with `sky-overlay-*`.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and meta lines on `background`. The site's most-used text colour.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, FAQ rows, pricing panels on `background`.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Deepest surface: the frame around the hero, footer, inset panels.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines on cards and dividers. Borders, not shadows, separate surfaces.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside cards on `muted` or `card-secondary`.

tokens.name: card-foreground-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text inside cards on `muted` or `card-secondary`.

tokens.name: card-secondary
tokens.usage: Teal-tinted card fill for the AI and automation stories, so they read apart from website cards.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hinterland teal. Primary buttons, links, the italic serif accent word, focus rings. One accent per view.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (5.2:1). Never cream on teal.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Gold highlighter underline under one key phrase per headline (the 'stand out' underline), and the ✦ glyph. Never body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element, on every surface.

tokens.name: sky-overlay-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the navy gradient laid over the painted sky so cream text reads.

tokens.name: sky-overlay-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop (55%) of the sky overlay; lets the swirls show through.

tokens.name: sky-overlay-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the sky overlay, where buttons and small text sit.

families.serif: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Websites that stand out in the age of AI.
styles.usage: Hero headline on desktop. 54px on phones.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.sample: Voice notes become a to-do list

styles.name: accent-italic
styles.usage: One word per headline, in `accent`. Matches the size of the headline it sits in.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Project and client names in cards.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Anyone can generate a website now. That's why most of them look alike.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, max 34rem wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tell me about your business. I reply within a day.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: The team sends a voice note on Telegram. It gets written up, sorted and put on the shop's board.
styles.usage: Card body and most supporting copy, in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a section heading.

styles.name: eyebrow-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase tag on cards: the client type.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit (Tailwind --spacing .25rem). Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and tag rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The site's most-used gap: stacked text in cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between section blocks.

tokens.name: space-frame
tokens.usage: Inset of the hero inside the `frame` from 850px up.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small inputs and tags.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Inner panels and board columns.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Cards: the default card corner.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Large feature panels.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: The hero's rounded corners and carousel image panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Every button and chip is a pill.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting buttons and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-2xl
tokens.usage: Website screenshots floating over a surface.

carousel.note: LinkedIn document carousels, exported as one PDF.

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: Carousel slide width.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: Carousel slide height (4:5 portrait, the largest feed size).

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Safe margin on every slide edge; nothing but backgrounds goes inside it.
